payload.text: **Confirm the Tactile install hint's URL live** (issue 0014): extensions.gnome.org resolved from neither rhadamanth (unsandboxed) nor kovacs on 16 Oct, while github.com did. From a plain terminal, `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{redirect_url}\n' 'https://extensions.gnome.org/download-extension/tactile@lundal.io.shell-extension.zip?shell_version=50.1'` should give a 302 to a versioned zip.
